issue: Below the hero, the three styles of each surface follow one section order with new labels. appmeta-a ≡ appmeta-b, gymlogger-x-a ≡ -b ≡ -c, rightsplit-b ≡ -c, shogiful-b ≡ -c, wanderwiki-a ≡ -b (-c swaps two blocks) and pawza-a ≡ -c. The xiangqiful, earnlock and millrace trios each differ by one swap. Across the 60 microsite styles, one order dominates: hero → quick answer → (quick reference) → how it works → screenshots → features → who_for/who_not_for → price → comparison → privacy → founder/about → (roadmap) → FAQ → further reading → closing. That is one static structure in 60 costumes, which is the thing the owner refused ('do not use the same static structure for each page, build them from scratch'). It also makes the three styles per page skin choices, not page choices.
fix: Re-derive every visitorPath from the world's own reading order, and enforce two rules. (1) Within a surface, no two styles may share the relative order of more than two of {price, screenshots, comparison, privacy record, founder, FAQ}. (2) At least one style per surface must change GROUPING, not just order: for example, FAQ split into the sections it answers, who_for/who_not_for folded into the price, or the privacy record as the opener. World-native examples: tare-b sets Puzzle No. 1 before the Rules and puts price and answers at the back like a book. studio-a, allpaid-c and rightsplit-a open with the record (bin label, statement, label data) before any feature. soon-b prints the fare and stub (price) on the face, first. gymlogger-x-c shows the plateau formula before any offer. xiangqiful-c files each FAQ as a margin question on the entry it concerns. observa-b ends on 'past issues' (release notes) instead of a closing CTA block. The maker/freshness line and the shared footer strip may stay common.

issue: Its whole type system is gymlogger-x-b's: Chivo 900/700 display, Chivo 400/600 text and Chivo Mono for data.
fix: gymlogger-x-b keeps Chivo. Set mockly-b in Spline Sans 400–700, with Spline Sans Mono for slug lines only. It is one superfamily and is unused elsewhere on the board.

issue: The Big Shoulders family is a display face in three surfaces: Big Shoulders Stencil Display (studio-a H1), Big Shoulders Display 800 (gymlogger-x-a door lettering) and Big Shoulders Display 800/600 (taskful-day-a letter tiles). The Stencil cut is the same skeleton, and the studio should share no display family with any microsite.
fix: Keep Big Shoulders Display on gymlogger-x-a, where municipal locker plates are its native register. studio-a sets its stencil in Allerta Stencil, which is unused on the board; it has one weight, so the 150px size carries it. taskful-day-a leaves the family with its replacement world (see the taskful-day-a issue).

issue: Three White Lights is the split hero in costume. The H1, subheadline and a badge/price/QR slip are stacked on the left, and a device (the black judging console) fills the right. Its ground (#d5e3ec bench-card blue + #121619 ink + red) is wanderwiki-a's aerogramme palette (#DCE6F1 + #15223D + #C4232D). It also echoes soon-c's pale blue-grey console with one black instrument.
fix: Run the light board across the full width as the stage, with the three lenses large and the verdict strip under them. Set the H1 above it and the hand-in slip below it. Ground the page in its white form paper (#FBFBF9), so the black housing is the only mass.

issue: Bilingual Concourse drenches in teal (#0E6A70) behind white enamel panels, just as gymlogger-x-a puts teal steel (#235c58) behind white laminated sheets. Its nav, opponent ladder and game record are metro line maps with station dots, interchange rings and a terminus bar. That is mediakit-b's whole world, the Zone 1 network.
fix: gymlogger-x-a keeps the teal, because RAL 6033 is its icon's check colour. mediakit-b keeps line maps: routing a file is wayfinding, and it is MediaKit's #1. Glaze xiangqiful-a's wall in a station colour no surface drenches in, e.g. grey-violet (~#5E5872), avoiding red/gold. Carry the game and the opponents with platform signage instead: direction boards, platform-number blades and bilingual exit lettering, with no octilinear lines or interchange rings.

issue: Public Sans is the text face of gymlogger-x-a, observa-b and soon-c, three surfaces.
fix: Keep it on observa-b and soon-c, where its public-service/US-government lineage is native (a public weather bulletin, a NASA-style press kit). Set gymlogger-x-a's laminated sheets and plates in Karla 400/600 (unused) with tabular figures.

issue: Phone in the Locker pairs a deep painted-steel teal ground with a single electric-orange action band. That is close to the gym category default of a dark ground with an electric-orange accent.
fix: Keep orange on the coiled key band and its tags only, never on buttons, links or the sticky bar, so it reads as an object rather than an accent system.

issue: Raster weight is unbudgeted everywhere. Every microsite puts the app icon in its nav or hero at 24 to 72px, and most put screenshots in carousels or heroes. The only files that exist are 1024px icon PNGs of 0.56 to 3.96 MB (mediakit.png is 3.96 MB; lagerland-mark.png is 1.96 MB, and the current header already ships it at 30px) and 1206x2622 screenshot PNGs of 0.3 to 7.6 MB (soon/2.png is 7.6 MB, mediakit/2.png is 7.1 MB). Nearly every card says assetsNeeded: none, so no style accounts for derivatives. Shipped as-is, a 390px page downloads several MB before the badge is usable.
fix: Add one production task to every style: a one-off script in scripts/ (already excluded from the build, so it is not a deploy build step) that commits derivatives. Icons at 64, 128 and 256px (WebP plus a PNG fallback, about 15 KB or less at 128). Screenshots at 400w, 800w and 1200w WebP (about 40, 90 and 160 KB or less). The studio mark as the clean SVG that studio a/b/c already ask for. Front matter keeps the original paths; one include maps them to the derivatives and emits width/height, srcset/sizes, loading=lazy and decoding=async (eager plus fetchpriority=high only for a single hero image).

issue: Sticky bars hide focus (WCAG 2.2 AA 2.4.11). Every style adds a sticky download bar after the hero, and most also pin a top strip; earnlock-c also fixes side rims, shogiful-a keeps a tag rail and soon-a an earth bar. A focused link, FAQ summary or #anchor target can land underneath them. On a Safari viewport of about 664px, two 52 to 64px bars plus the Smart App Banner can cover more than a quarter of the screen.
fix: Make it a global contract: html { scroll-padding-top: var(--sticky-top); scroll-padding-bottom: var(--sticky-bottom) }, so focus and anchors never land under a bar. Allow one sticky element per edge, pad the bottom bar with env(safe-area-inset-bottom), and on viewports shorter than 600px hide the top strip while the bottom bar is showing.

issue: The locker door can hide focus. With JS on, the closed door covers the screenshot shelf until the section is 35% in view. Tab, an in-page #hash link or find-in-page can land on screenshot links behind the closed door (WCAG 2.2 2.4.11). The '2.5s safety net' is ambiguous. If it is a page-load timer, the door is already open before anyone scrolls there, so the signature never plays. If it is missing, the door stays shut whenever IntersectionObserver doesn't fire. The rotateY(-105deg) swing with perspective 1800px also projects past the edge of a 390px viewport.
fix: Open the door on whichever happens first: IntersectionObserver at 35%, :focus-within on the interior, :target or hash navigation, or beforeprint. Start the safety net 2.5s after the section first intersects, not after page load. Once open, the door is aria-hidden with pointer-events:none. Give the section overflow: clip so the swing can't cause horizontal scroll.

issue: Contrast: form red #D32B1F on the blue attempt stock #D5E3EC is 3.88:1, not the 5.3:1 claimed, so red form headers and verdict-strip text fail AA for normal-size text.
fix: Use #BD261B for red text on the blue stock (4.64:1), and keep #D32B1F for lenses and fills only.

issue: Shared faces. Big Shoulders Display is also taskful-day-a's display, and studio-a uses the same design as Big Shoulders Stencil, which makes three surfaces. Public Sans is also the text face of observa-b and soon-c, another three.
fix: Keep Big Shoulders on taskful-day-a (marquee tiles) and Public Sans on observa-b and soon-c. Move gymlogger-x-a to Teko 700 (a squared athletic condensed suited to cut vinyl, 7 KB) and Ubuntu Sans 400/600 (16 to 17 KB) with tabular figures for kg and prices.

issue: Shared display face: Chivo plus Chivo Mono is also mockly-b's complete stack.
fix: Keep Chivo on mockly-b, whose press-proof slugs belong to the Akzidenz-line job-printer sans Chivo descends from. Move gymlogger-x-b to Reddit Sans 900/400/600 plus Reddit Mono 500, another matched sans and mono pair, about 65 KB.

issue: Layout shift from huge display headlines. Many heroes set 100 to 128px condensed or expanded H1s (millrace-c Antonio at 128px, soon-b at 128px, allpaid-a at 112px, gymlogger-x-a at 112px, liftlog-a at wdth 125). When the font swaps in from a system fallback with very different widths, the H1 reflows and the hero shifts.
fix: For each display face, declare a metric-matched fallback @font-face (size-adjust, ascent-override and descent-override over a local system face), preload only the display file, and use font-display: swap for text faces and optional for the giant H1 face.

issue: quick_answer, which each style renders high and marks speakable, says the app 'flags plateaus when an exercise stalls for nine or more sessions of consistent effort'. plateau_disclosure and how_it_works say something else: a trend over the four most recent non-deload sessions, at least 8 sessions on the lift, 12 weeks of history, and a 6-session run or fatigue signal to confirm. Styles b and c run the published rule live on six sessions, right beside the contradicting Quick Answer. Style a prints the rule sheet under it.
fix: Before build, rewrite the quick_answer clause to match plateau_disclosure, e.g. 'flags a plateau when estimated 1RM stops clearing your own improvement threshold across your last four non-deload sessions while volume holds (it needs 8+ sessions on the lift and 12 weeks of history)'. The AEO answer and the demo must state one rule.

issue: The trust plates (a), the announcement facts line (b) and the note-cell facts row (c) state '0 third-party SDKs · no account', and none is specified as linked.
fix: Link the plates or line to /transparency/#gymlogger-x.

issue: /apps/gymlogger-x/coaches/ is an existing permalinked sub-page, but no read-mode variant mentions it. They cover only privacy, support and Strong, Fitbod and Jefit, so it has no world and no specified seo block.
fix: Add the coaches page to each style's read mode, keeping its permalink, title and seo.
